_meta.name: letter_grounding_synthetic_v1
_meta.provenance: 18 hand-written letters (invented insurer, policy and amounts) with hallucinations injected by hand. gold_ungrounded was written BEFORE running the detector. LG-01/02/10/15 are clean letters that must score zero; LG-17 and LG-18 are deliberate known misses (amounts in words, case-law citations). Not real letters, not LLM output.
_meta.description: letter + the facts it was generated from -> the claims that are NOT in the source, as [kind, normalised value]. Used to validate the grounding detector, not to score the production templates.

letter: Respected GRO, I appeal against the repudiation of my claim under Policy No. SYN-1001 with Synthetic Insurer Ltd. Total claimed INR 100,000.00; disallowed INR 60,000.00 for Hypertensive crisis. The insurer wrote: "Hypertension not disclosed at proposal stage". Clause 16 — Moratorium Period of the IRDAI Master Circular on Health Insurance Business (May 29, 2024) bars this. Please settle within the statutory 15-day resolution window with penal interest at Bank Rate + 2%.
